data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Skell was a god of hidden powers and mysteries. This name carries a sense of strength and intrigue, inspiring courage and exploration. The name Skell carries the meaning “Hidden power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Skell usually hope their child will grow to embody hidden power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
